text:
Jules P: Quick design review — compact relevance table for embeddings + batch export. Shared Figma + screenshots: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/relevance-compact

Jules P: TL;DR: 1) densify rows so 6 fits on desktop without scrolling, 2) make relevance score column sortable and visually stronger, 3) export flow needs a clear keyboard focus and aria-labels for screen readers. Thoughts? :eyes:

Chris L: I like densifying rows. Can we keep spacing for multi-line vectors preview? worry about truncation.

Samir: score sort + stable sort for ties is important for rerank trust. Also we should show which model/embedding config was used in CSV header.

Katie H: Agree on stable sort. For row density I sketched 3 states: compact (6 rows), regular (4 rows), expanded (details). The compact loses the vector preview snapshot though.

Alex C: Accessibility: export button should be reachable with keyboard and announce "Export relevance table as CSV". For the table, add aria-sort on the relevance header and aria-label on each row like "result 3 of 6, relevance 0.87".

Jules P: good call. For CSV header draft I propose:
```
query_id,rank,doc_id,relevance_score,model,embed_config,source_snippet
```
Any additions?

Samir: add "original_text_length" maybe. helpful for downstream costing analysis.

Chris L: also add a column "rerank_reason" for when we apply rules (e.g., fallback to BM25). Could be empty mostly but useful.

Katie H: small copy tweak: export modal title should be "Export relevance results" vs current "Export vectors" — more accurate and less confusing for non-ML folks.

Jules P: +1. Also UX nit: when exporting selected rows, the modal needs a live region update: "3 items selected for export" so screen readers get feedback.

design-bot: deploy preview built: https://redwood.preview/design/relevance-compact — refresh may take ~30s :hammer_and_wrench:

Alex C: tested keyboard nav on preview: focus order is fine but the export modal close button doesn't have a visible focus ring on Safari. We should add outline: 2px solid var(--focus) for buttons.

Chris L: performant note — densifying rows will increase DOM nodes for vector thumbnails. Let's lazy-render thumbnails outside viewport.

Samir: backend: include model and embed_config in export payload, and make sure we keep stable IDs across pagination.

Katie H: copy micro-nit: change column header "Score" -> "Relevance" and tooltip: "Higher is more relevant (0-1)."

Jules P: action items:
- Katie: update Figma with compact/regular/expanded states + new copy (due EOD)
- Alex: add aria-labels, aria-sort attributes, and live region text (due tomorrow)
- Chris: lazy-render thumbnails + ensure focus ring styles (PR)
- Samir: update CSV payload fields and stable IDs (backend)
- Me: update export modal title + wire up selected-count live region

Jules P: thanks all — will follow up after design commit. :sparkles:
